metadata.description: Claude Code plugins maintained by Hantsch.

plugins.name: ai-scrum
plugins.description: Installs a spec-driven AI Scrum workflow into your repository: roadmap -> concept -> story -> refine -> build -> sprint. Commands, agents and state all live in the project, so the plugin is only needed to install and update them.

plugins.name: common
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic building blocks for every project: output styles Briefing and KIS, the karpathy behavioral skill, and the premortem and secrets-scan commands.

plugins.name: dotnet
plugins.description: House rules for modular ASP.NET Core backends: layering and naming, a discoverable composition root without extension methods, hand-written-fake unit tests, and a review command for diffs.

plugins.name: react
plugins.description: House rules for React/TypeScript frontends: Atomic Design layering with a hard dependency direction, mandatory primitives and duplicate scan, plus a semantic design-token method and the mobile accessibility floor.

plugins.name: electron
plugins.description: House rules for Electron apps: main/preload/renderer layering with a hardened trust boundary, contract-first typed IPC, Playwright UI verification, plus one-time templates for an env-scrubbing launcher and a self-healing JSON store.
